analogy.rationale: MAP kinase inhibitors block the RAS-RAF-MEK-ERK cascade, so MEK and RAF inhibitors should phenocopy their transcriptional response most closely, with upstream receptor tyrosine kinase inhibitors (EGFR) and other MAPK-family inhibitors (p38) producing partially overlapping effects.
